hooks.text: 死亡会重置时间循环，城堡布局随每次复活改写
hooks.excerpt: Every time you die, you will reappear in the same place, as in stuck in a neverending time loop… but the castle will have changed its layout, forcing you to begin your path anew!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 近远程武器、魔法与多棵技能树自由拼出每局流派
hooks.excerpt: Nigate Tale gives you total freedom to choose your own playstyle, with dozens of weapons of all kinds (melee and ranged, slow but strong and weak but fast…), different types of magic , and several skills trees for you to level up, creating in every playthrough a unique character to fight with.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 给怪物少女送对礼物，换取魔法加护与并肩作战
hooks.excerpt: this castle is also inhabited by friendly monster girls, capable of granting you magical powers and even fight by your side… if you manage to befriend them and bring them the right presents!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
